description: List the products the user buys at Picnic, per aisle, e.g. for "what do I usually buy?" or to offer products for "my usual groceries". Without input it lists the aisles with a few products each; pass an aisleId for all of the user's products in that aisle. Products have ids for add_to_cart; add only the ones the user asks for.

aisleId.description: An aisleId from get_favorites, e.g. DAIRY. Leave out for the overview.

name: get_favorites
title: Get favorites
